provenance.rule: features reduced to the unconditional VK_VERSION_1_0..1_3 feature requirements of vk.xml; limits and properties are the base profile's minimums, but where the Vulkan 1.2 specification states another (spec_corrections); plus the m2v_required_features block: each such requirement the base profile omits (added_features); plus the m2v_unrequired_properties block: the weakest value the specification permits for each property the product reads, and the profiles layer sets, that the base profile leaves without a requirement; plus the m2v_runtime_floor block: the device extensions, features and limits metal2vulkan-runtime's floor requires (crates/metal2vulkan-runtime/src/floor.rs), each limit at the value the floor needs; its queue family, timestamp bits, memory types and time domains have no profiles-schema form; where a feature a block requires fixes or conditions a property, the specification's value for a device with the feature (feature_limits)

required_formats.rule: the Required Format Support tables of the Vulkan 1.2 specification, read by scripts/regen-device-profiles/required_formats.py: m2v_vulkan12_required_formats holds every unconditional entry and m2v_vulkan12_required_formats_if_<feature> the entries a feature this profile requires makes unconditional; `conditional` lists every conditional requirement (at least one table of `any_of` holds in full, on a device supporting `if_feature` when present)

not_represented.text: pname:bufferFeatures must: not support any features for these formats

VP_M2V_runtime_floor.label: the runtime's floor: Vulkan 1.3 required features and minimum limits, and what metal2vulkan-runtime requires of every device
